text:
marie: Heads-up — we're seeing noisy PD alerts for cache-thrashing (cache-miss-rate > 15% spikes) hitting infra oncall and product. Where's the best dash to look at traces/metrics so I can attach a permalink? Also thinking we should change routing: infra first, then infra-ops fallback, then product. Is that ok? /cc @jordan

jordan: Use Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/alerts/cache-miss-rate?orgId=1&panelId=2 — the traces link is on the panel (Open in Tempo). If you want permalinks, click the share icon. :thumbsup:

marie: thanks. can someone confirm current PD escalation policy for the "cache-thrash" service? I see it's going to infra -> product. Want infra only for <5min, then escalate to product after 10m.

sachin: current PD service id: svc_abc123 (PagerDuty). Routing rules right now: level1 infra, level2 product. I can propose a small change. Draft suggestion below:
```
- escalation_rules:
  - delay: 0m
    targets: [team:infra-oncall]
  - delay: 10m
    targets: [team:product-oncall]
  - automatic_ack: true
```

oncall-bot: deploy_check: There's an existing automation that auto-acks alerts with tag "transient":true for the first 2m. Confirm before changing.

jordan: Also suggest adding a suppression filter: suppress if >=3 alerts with same fingerprint in 60s. And mark alerts with runbook_triggered==false as low-priority when routing to infra.

olivia: I'm infra today — +1 to infra-first with a 10m handoff. If sachin pushes the policy change, can you also add the Grafana + Tempo links to the PD service description? Makes triage faster.

sachin: will push the policy change and add dashboard links to PD. I'll also add the suppression rule. Plan: apply change, then post confirmation here.

marie: please also add a short runbook note: "if high CPU observed alongside cache-miss >15% — escalate to SRE immediately". That cutoff has saved us before.

sachin: update complete. PD service description now includes: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/alerts/cache-miss-rate and Tempo traces link. Escalation policy updated (infra 0m, product 10m), suppression: 3 in 60s. rollout id: rollout_20260317_1

jordan: LGTM. marie — can you validate during tomorrow's spike window and report any noise regressions?

marie: will validate during the 09:00-10:30 spike window tomorrow. thanks all :raised_hands:

oncall-bot: note: escalation policy change applied by sachin at 2026-03-17T18:14:11Z
